selection_rule: per repository: newest commit with a successful dev push Branch CI run that is on dev (ancestor of tip or tip) and ahead of the served commit; else the served commit if still on dev; else waiting_for_ci

older_payload_sources.workflow_definition: dev tip the workflow was dispatched on (GITHUB_REF refs/heads/dev, GITHUB_SHA)
older_payload_sources.deploy_scripts: the older payload checkout (.target/scripts/*, ref = inputs.ref)

workflow_admission: payload must be an ancestor of origin/dev and have a latest completed:success dev push Branch CI run; frontend likewise in execute-plans; off-dev or non-green payloads are refused
residual_findings: GITHUB_SHA-based workflow-source pinning is no longer equal to the payload; later jobs in the workflow that re-check origin/dev tip equality (isolated qualification, hosted all-12, restore baseline) were intentionally left unchanged as they are not the automatic dev deploy path.
Candidate ordering uses Branch CI run id, not commit topology; at most 30 recent green runs are examined.
